'''Valgauth''' was one of three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Valgauth system/Legends|Valgauth system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], and the only one to support any life. It was covered in barren wastelands and junk fields.

==Description==
Its local day lasted 26 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]]; its year 669 [[Local day/Legends|local days]]. It was originally a mineral-rich world and was setup as a manufacturing center. As the resources were depleted, it was abandoned and became a dumping ground for unwanted machinery and waste products. The only inhabitants were droids that were left to perform automated maintenance on the buildings. [[Saujutta-Ok-Topii]] saw the potential in the planet and arranged for [[Syndicate One]] to purchase it. To hide its true purpose and keep it obscure, the company had the planet re-classified on star charts as a airless [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].<ref name="AJ8" />

Valgauth had constant precipitation. The moisture in the air would contact the surface and evaporate, creating a corrosive vapor that would condense and fall to the ground again. A benefit of the atmosphere was that it made it extremely hard for [[Sensor/Legends|sensor scans]] to detect anything on the planet. Any vehicle entering the atmosphere had to be steam sterilized within 20 hours or risk suffering mechanical and electrical malfunctions.<ref name="AJ8" />

The planet was the location of [[The Yard (Valgauth)|The Yard]], headquarters of Syndicate One. The planet was used as an arms manufacturing hub for the company.<ref name="AJ8" />
